title: Quant-profile pipeline operator and artifact lifecycle
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: Build a flexible pipeline operator inside Redwood Console that manages quantization profile runs (FP8/INT8), stores resulting artifacts with versioning and retention rules, and exposes validation traces so engineers can certify accuracy regressions before promoting profiles to serving. Scope includes run lifecycle (start/cancel/retry), artifact metadata and storage, retention/GC policies, access control integration with RBAC/KMS, and a minimal validation UI. Non-goals: implementing new quant algorithms or model-specific kernel changes.
acceptance_criteria: Console can schedule a quant-profile pipeline run (FP8/INT8) with user-specified calibration dataset and config.
Each run produces an artifact bundle (profile file, calibration logs, sample inference outputs, metrics.json) stored in object storage with an immutable versioned key.
Users can set per-project retention rules (TTL or manual archive) and view estimated storage cost before applying a policy.
RBAC: Only users with 'quant_run:create' can start runs; 'quant_run:promote' required to mark a profile as production-ready. Audit logs record user, timestamp, and run digest.
Automated accuracy validation compares baseline and candidate profile outputs using a configurable metric set and surfaces a pass/fail with confidence bands in UI and API.
API endpoints documented for starting runs, querying artifacts, and applying retention policies; integration tests cover end-to-end flow.
Encryption at rest via customer KMS keys when project has 'private' deployment flag enabled.
run_flow_spec: Users create a run from Console or API: POST /api/v1/quant-runs with model_version, dataset_ref, quant_target (FP8|INT8), and config. The operator schedules worker job on Dedicated or Hosted pool, streams status (queued, running, validating, succeeded, failed). On completion the operator uploads artifacts to S3 with key pattern: <project>/<model>/<run_id>/v<artifact_version>/ and writes a run manifest to the metadata DB. Retries follow exponential backoff; transient failures move run to 'failed-retryable' with reason codes.
ui_changes: New 'Quant Runs' tab under Model detail showing run list, status badges, quick actions (retry, cancel, promote, download artifact). Run detail pane shows timeline, metrics charts (accuracy delta, latency histogram, token-cost delta), and a 'validation verdict' card with links to failing samples. Settings page to configure default retention policy and storage class (hot/cold).
api_contracts: Start run: POST /api/v1/quant-runs {model_id, dataset_id, quant_mode, config}. Get run: GET /api/v1/quant-runs/{run_id}. List artifacts: GET /api/v1/quant-runs/{run_id}/artifacts. Apply retention: POST /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/retention {policy}. Promote profile: POST /api/v1/profiles/{profile_id}/promote. All endpoints require scope-scoped tokens; responses include run_manifest_url and signed artifact URLs.
retention_policy: Default project-level retention = 90 days. Policies supported: TTL (days), archive-to-cold-store (move after X days), keep-manual (no auto-delete). Admins can set hard caps per-project; when storage budget exceeded old artifact versions are queued for GC and owners notified. UI warns when policy will delete artifacts used by an active model.
permissions_model: Integrate with existing Console RBAC. New granular permissions: quant_run:create, quant_run:read, quant_run:delete, quant_run:promote, quant_artifact:download. In Private deployments honor customer SSO groups mapped to roles. Promotion requires both project-level 'promote' and team-level 'approve' approval workflow (two-person rule) when customer_enforced_promotions=true.
testing_and_validation: Smoke tests: start/run/succeed flow. Integration tests for artifact storage + signed URL generation. Validation harness runs deterministic sample set to assert accuracy delta < configured threshold. E2E QA: simulate failed workers and ensure retries, ensure KMS-encrypted artifacts decrypt correctly. Load test to ensure console handles 500 concurrent run listings.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): expose to 10 internal teams with feature flag; collect feedback for 2 weeks. Phase 2: open to all self-serve projects; default retention 90 days. Phase 3: add archive-to-cold-store and cross-project artifact sharing. Rollback plan: disable start-run API and mark running operator pods to drain; retain artifacts unchanged.
notes: 2025-02-11 - PM sync: agreed on storing immutable artifact bundles rather than mutating profile files (Aisha).
2025-02-12 - ENG feedback: prefer versioned keys over TTL-only to simplify reproducibility (Diego).
2025-02-13 - Security review: must support customer KMS for private deploys; also add audit events for promotion (security@redwood).
GH draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1129 (operator controller + API routes)
Slack thread: #quantization-ops thread ts=1707750000 - initial design debate on storing raw samples vs diffs
Known risk: storing sample outputs for every run can explode storage — mitigation: sample reservoir + sampling policy and estimated cost display.
Decision: validation threshold defaults to 0.5% top-token match or 1% task-specific metric; teams can override per-run config.
